_note: DEMO DATA for the portal design preview. Invented suggestions, people and notes. Nothing here is real.

suggestions.title: Sports day for a girls' home in Kilinochchi
suggestions.description: Our home looks after 35 girls aged 6 to 15. They have never had a proper sports day with prizes. We would love a morning of races and games and a lunch together.
suggestions.additional: Any Saturday in November works for us.

suggestions.title: School bags and books for Grade 1 children
suggestions.description: Forty children start Grade 1 in January in a village school near Batticaloa. Many families cannot buy a bag, books or pencils.

suggestions.title: A day at the fun fair for children of fishing families
suggestions.description: Children from a small fishing village have never been to the fun fair in Jaffna town. A bus and tickets would make their year.

notes.text: I know this village. Happy to visit next week.

suggestions.title: Zoo trip for children with special needs
suggestions.description: A day centre for 18 children with special needs would like a trip to the zoo, with carers travelling with them.

notes.text: Called the centre. Visit booked for 14 October.

suggestions.title: Christmas lunch at a children's home
suggestions.description: A home with 30 children would like a special Christmas lunch with small gifts.

notes.text: Visited. Lovely home, the need is real. Rough budget $400.

suggestions.title: Cricket kit for a village team
suggestions.description: Our under-19 team needs bats, pads and a kit bag.

notes.text: Outside our focus (equipment, not a day of joy). Replied kindly and shared another group's contact.

reports.what: The bus came almost two hours late and the children waited outside in the sun with no water. Nobody called to tell us.

reports.comment: Sasi was kind and patient with the children and explained everything clearly.
Good visit. We would have liked a phone call before he came.
